protocol.overlap_rule: discard an entire candidate sequencing read or disclosed positive proxy if its identity occurs in either model training or validation metadata
protocol.pairing: exact original-window lineage intersection of the frozen task-specific test sets
protocol.sixclass_prediction: unchanged full six-way argmax; predicting the other XNA class remains an error

limitations: Natural samples have sequencing-read identity; historical positive samples retain disclosed source-row-proxy identity and the original one-row-per-positive-read assumption.
Paired testing compares the final trained systems; differing training data quantities prevent attributing differences solely to class count.
The intersection is a post hoc common held-out subset, not a new external test or template/run holdout.
ambiguous_alias_rule: Non-unique aliases are ignored; a test pair must have another unique original-window alias. UUID or motif alone is never used.
